title: I'm making a sim where you run a figure shop and arcade in 2005
author: SHAY-PSY
selftext:
you run a small collectible figure shop, around 2005. you order stock, open blind boxes, set prices, and haggle with people who walk in to sell you figures, some of them fakes.  
over time the shop grows into a little game center- capsule machines, a crane game and many more  
the look I'm going for is heisei retro: purple walls, fluorescent lights, an old cinema carpet, and a slightly empty, liminal feel after closing time.  
made in Godot. it's still early and doesn't have a name yet

How it's made: I design and direct, and Claude (Claude Code) writes the GDScript. Most of the shop is built in code from simple shapes and shaders. The figures are made in Meshy and prepared for the game with a Blender script. A second Claude chat checks every stage before it reaches me: it runs headless tests and a bot that plays 8 days of the shop to check the balance.

I'm a music producer, and I'll write the music and the sound effects myself. The sounds in the game right now are placeholders.

AI disclosure: the code was written with an AI coding assistant (Claude), and the figure models were made with Meshy, an AI 3D tool, then prepared for the game. The shop's furniture and textures are generated in code. The design, direction and testing are mine.
